column11: AstraZeneca's own Vermont prescriber price disclosure, Calquence short form of 2026-09-30 (astrazeneca-us.com/pharmaceutical-marketer-price-disclosure-vermont.html): Calquence 100 mg tablet at $326.08. The filing states on its face that, as directed by the Vermont Attorney General's Office, the prices shown are Wholesale Acquisition Cost plus 20%, so WAC is 326.08 / 1.20 = $271.73 a tablet. The Calquence prescribing information (DailyMed setid dd4835ef-e1bc-4997-a399-1ffa2556fbfe, effective 2026-03-05) gives 100 mg every 12 hours until progression: 2 tablets a day, 730 a year. 730 x 271.73 = $198,365 a year. Cross-check: CMS Medicare Part D Spending by Drug 2024 shows $1,701,974,920.80 over 6,844,352 dosage units, $248.67 a tablet gross, two years earlier and 8% under the 2026 WAC
